title: Integrating Social Determinants of Health into Knowledge Graphs: Evaluating Prediction Bias and Fairness in Healthcare
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and demographic bias within healthcare knowledge graphs using Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs). While fairness is a moral and ethical concept, the study specifically addresses social determinants of health (SDoH) rather than religion, spiritual traditions, theology, or broader moral/ethical systems.
